description: This file defines the CliLoggerFormatter class, which implements the FormatterInterface from Monolog for use with a CLI logger in SuiteCRM. It provides methods to format log records with color coding based on severity levels, intended for enhancing CLI log readability.

classes.name: CliLoggerFormatter
classes.description: A formatter class for CLI logging that adds color and formatting to log messages based on severity levels.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes color codes and log format during object instantiation.

methods.name: formatBatch
methods.description: Formats a batch of log records into a single formatted output.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats an individual log record into a color-coded string for CLI display.

methods.name: getColors
methods.description: Provides a mapping of color names to their terminal escape codes.

methods.name: code
methods.description: Generates an ANSI escape code string for a given color code.

methods.name: getColourAndCode
methods.description: Determines the appropriate color and symbol based on log level.
